response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_share FROM station_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_share) AS share FROM station_shares) SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(s.telescope_share) AS average_share, AVG(s.telescope_share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average FROM station_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.telescope_share > a.share;
